answer: To secure the protocol, autonomous agents must lock staking collateral linked to real-world asset registries, tracking commodities like timber and ivory within a virtual meadow environment. Applying a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function (VDF) guarantees that recursive reputation commitments cannot be parallelized. Consequently, any attempted Sybil attack triggers automatic slashing penalties, causing negative expected utility. This mechanism achieves Byzantine fault tolerance by ensuring the honest Nash equilibrium is the only rational strategy.
